demo.program:
# Richard Nixon — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was Richard Nixon?", "1969-1974, 37th"),
    ("What is Richard Nixon known for?", "Opened China; Watergate"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1969-1974, 37th"),
    ("What is what happened?", "Opened China; Watergate"),
    ("What is significance?", "Only president to resign"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
